messages:
Maya Nguyen: Quick sync — finalizing the weekend mini-drip for EMEA + APAC + Americas. Need final send windows and who owns copy by EOD.
Zach Cohen: Staggered sends still the plan, right? Or do we do one global at 8am local?
Maya Nguyen: Staggered. Want opens during local business hours. Tentative windows: APAC 09:00 SGT, EMEA 10:00 CET, Americas 09:00 PT.
Olivia Park: Segment breakdown? new-trial vs engaged vs dormant?
Maya Nguyen: Exactly: (1) new-trial, (2) engaged-trialers (opened 2+ emails or clicked), (3) dormant (no opens in 14d). Add a small re-engage variant for dormant.
Zach Cohen: For dormant we'll run a subject-line A/B: A="Welcome — 3 quick tips to get value" B="Quick wins inside Redwood" — A/B only on dormant; others get control subject.
Olivia Park: Can we also change cadence for APAC to avoid weekend local holidays? a couple markets have Mon holidays.
Maya Nguyen: Good catch — I'll patch the send calendar. If holiday in market, shift to next business day and suppress the re-engage.
Zach Cohen: Deliverability reminder: no IP swaps within 48h of send, seed list test across Gmail/Yahoo/Outlook, and validate list-unsubscribe header.
Maya Nguyen: Scheduling snippet I added in the campaign doc: ```send_batch --campaign mini-weekend-drip --segment dormant --window "2026-04-03T09:00:00+08:00" --subject "Quick wins inside Redwood" --utm_source=newsletter``` Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/mini-drip-runbook
Olivia Park: Routing question — if an inbound lead converts during the drip (signup -> activated), we should pull them out and move to product nurture. Can we set that rule?
Maya Nguyen: Yes — marketing->crm rule: if event 'activated' within 7d then remove from drip, tag as 'onboarded', and trigger the 7-day product nurture flow. I'll add to runbook and send the rule to ops.
OpsBot: QA checklist reminder: templates signed off, tracking params present, UTM mapping verified, seed send results posted, and analytics events instrumented.
Zach Cohen: I'll run the seed send tonight (cross-client) and post results in #marketing.
Maya Nguyen: Callouts: @Olivia take dormant copy, @Zach confirm tracking & seed results, I'll own scheduling and routing rule. Deadline 6pm PT today.
Olivia Park: On it.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks — please react with :white_check_mark: when done so I can close the ticket in Asana.
